description: List bank transactions already matched in a building, optionally between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD), with what each one is matched to: the payment, expense, refund or cash transfer it covered, including every part of a split match. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

from.description: Inclusive start day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to no lower bound.

limit.description: Maximum matched transactions to return. Defaults to 200.

to.description: Inclusive end day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to no upper bound.

name: list_matched_bank_transactions
title: Matched bank transactions
